package application

import "github.com/NARUBROWN/spine/pkg/httpx"

type PreviewPath struct { ID int64 `path:"id"` }
type PreviewQuery struct {
    Tags []string `query:"tag"`
    Page *int `query:"page" validate:"omitempty,min=1"`
}
type PreviewHeaders struct { Host string `header:"Host"` }
type PreviewResult struct {
    ID int64 `json:"id"`
    Tags []string `json:"tags"`
    Host string `json:"host"`
}
type PreviewController struct{}
func NewPreviewController() *PreviewController { return &PreviewController{} }
func (*PreviewController) Get(path *PreviewPath, query *PreviewQuery, headers *PreviewHeaders) httpx.Response[PreviewResult] {
    return httpx.Response[PreviewResult]{Body: PreviewResult{path.ID, query.Tags, headers.Host}}
}
